title: compact-route-creation-steps-and-microcopy-probe
body:
Context:
This is a focused exploration of a compact, keyboard-first endpoint route creator and microcopy variants for the model catalog + version-pin step. Objective is a lean flow for power-users and a progressive-disclosure secondary path for novices. Fits next to full endpoint wizard work but is intentionally trimmed: fewer screens, single-column, explicit defaults, and clear lock semantics for pinning.

Top-level design intents (quick):
- Single-line compact creator: route name + model selector + mode (stable/experimental) + create.
- Inline model variant pin: a small lock icon next to the model chip that expands to a compact modal for choosing exact version or auto-follow semantics.
- Progressive disclosure for advanced settings (batching, cache TTL, quantization profile) hidden behind an "Advanced ▼" chip.
- Keyboard-first: Enter to create, Ctrl+Enter to open advanced settings, Arrow keys to toggle model chip dropdown.
- Accessible: aria-live announcements for pin state and fallback messages; visible focus rings; single accessible label for the primary action.

Wireframe writeup (step-by-step):
1) Compact Route Bar (single row)
   - Left: input "Route name" (placeholder: my-sales-chat)
   - Middle: model chip selector (shows model name and small caret). E.g., "gpt-open-v1 • quantized"
   - Right of chip: tiny lock-outline icon (pin control), small dropdown chevron, primary CTA "Create route" (primary).
   - Helper text under bar: short one-liner: "Creates a route that maps /api/chat to the chosen model. Pin a version to guarantee responses stable across deploys."

2) Model selector interaction (open)
   - Full-width dropdown anchored to chip. Rows: model name, latest-version badge, latency cost score (icons), region availability. Keyboard filter at top.
   - Each row has a subtle right-side vertical ellipsis for "inspect model" (goes to catalog).

3) Pin flow (lock icon expanded)
   - Microdialog: small card (max-width 420px) with three columns: 
     * Left: primary state radio (Auto-follow "Use latest compatible"),
     * Middle: explicit version list (stable-2025-01-15, stable-2024-12-12, quantized-v2), selectable.
     * Bottom: fallback policy dropdown (fallback to cheaper-compatible / fallback to hosted-compat / error-out).
   - Copy note at bottom line (muted): "Pinning prevents automatic model updates. Use auto-follow to get minor improvements while preserving API shape."

4) Create with immediate feedback
   - After hit Create: microtoast shows "Route created — 1m for initial warmup. Serving traffic routed to model variant: stable-2025-01-15 (pinned)" with a link "View route".
   - If no pin chosen and the workspace policy requires pinning, show inline validation: red underline + message: "Your org requires pinned routes for production. Choose a version or select Auto-follow with review enabled."

Microcopy variants (short list to A/B test):
- Primary helper: 
  * Variant A: "Creates a named route that sends requests to this model. You can pin to freeze the exact model version."
  * Variant B: "Map a route to a model. Pin a version to keep responses consistent across updates."
  * Variant C (concise): "Create route — pin to lock version."

- Pin control label: 
  * A: "Pin version (recommended for production)"
  * B: "Lock to a specific model version"
  * C: "Auto-follow latest (beta)"

- Fallback choices wording:
  * A: "Fallback: use cheaper-compatible model"
  * B: "If unavailable, serve from regional replica"
  * C: "If not compatible, return error to client"

Edge cases & acceptance notes:
- If chosen variant is incompatible with route settings (e.g., different context window), block create and show inline diff: "Selected version max-tokens 2048 — route default 4096. Update route or select another version."
- If org policy disallows auto-follow, hide auto-follow radio and show small alert: "Org policy: pinned routes required. Contact security-admin@redwood.com to request exception."
- If the pinned version is deprecated, banner: "Pinned version reaching end-of-life on 2025-06-01. Plan a pin update or enable fallback to avoid downtime."

Accessibility & voiceover notes:
- Pin dialog: role=dialog, focus trap on open, close with Esc. The lock icon toggles aria-pressed state. Announce: "Model version pinned: stable-2025-01-15" to aria-live polite.
- Dark mode: ensure the lock filled state remains high-contrast (do not rely solely on color).

Backlog grooming (candidate tasks, rough sizing):
- INFR-1023 Add compact route bar component (2d)
- INFR-1024 Keyboard navigation for model chip dropdown (1d)
- INFR-1025 Pin microdialog UI + API contract for version selection (3d)
- INFR-1026 Validation for context-window mismatch messages (1d)
- INFR-1027 Accessibility QA + screen reader script (1d)
- PRODUCT-891 Decide default fallback policy per org (grooming)

Notes on API interactions (dev-focused):
- Create route call should accept: {name, model_id, pinned_version_id: optional, fallback_policy: enum}. If pinned_version_id omitted and org requires pinning, return 422 with policy code.
- Microdialog should request a small list of recent stable versions (paginated) and indicate deprecation flags. Keep payload ~light: only ids, name, max_context, release_date.

Mock acceptance criteria (short):
- Can create a route with no pin (if allowed) and receives success toast + route listing pointing to chosen model.
- Can pin a specific version and route shows pin badge in catalog and route details.
- Org policy validation enforced at create-time and helpful error shown.
- Keyboard flows: tab order, Enter to accept, Esc to close dialog tested.

Open questions / trade-offs to resolve in grooming:
- Default for new users: auto-follow or pinned? (safe default likely: Auto-follow with a clear warning for production set to pinned).
- Should "pin" copy lean on operational language (freeze/lock) or friendlier "freeze version"?
- How aggressive should fallback defaults be (prefer availability vs. consistency)?

Design experiments to run next:
- Microcopy A/B: "pin" phrasing measured on user comprehension (5-min moderated sessions)
- Compact vs full wizard conversion test: time-to-create and errors for new vs power users
- Fallback defaults telemetry: track incidents where fallback policy prevented user-visible error over 3 months

Quick follow-ups for next sync:
- @Liam: wire a quick Figma compact prototype for keyboard flows (due 2025-02-18).
- @Morgan: draft copy variations for the OA (org admin) policy message.
- @Devon: check API contract with backend (ensure version list endpoint supports deprecation flag).

Rough sketch of telemetry events needed (for later):
- route.create.start, route.create.complete, route.create.fail(reason), route.pin.set (method:auto|manual), route.pin.deprecated-warning-shown, route.fallback.used

Raw sketch paste (notes-to-self):
- tiny lock = subtle affordance but important: need hover text "Pinned: shows version id" and long-press to open dialog on touch
- mobile: collapse model selector to inline list inside an expanding card; primary CTA remains sticky
- test with customers: ask 3 current beta customers if they want auto-follow or explicit pin default

End.
